headline: Weathered Expanse Battles Escalate As Linn Of Mercy Ignites Anew
war_summary: The central front has ruptured into fresh turmoil over the past three hours, led by an explosive flurry of eleven base exchanges across Weathered Expanse. Contestation around Frostmarch, Crow's Nest, and Wightwalk devoured over 2,800 casualties in two hours, keeping the frozen sector split four Warden positions to five Colonial. Linn of Mercy has abruptly reawakened from its brief lull, recording three sharp turnovers at Rotdust and Outwich Ranch to cement a ten-to-one Colonial lead, while adjacent Marban Hollow saw Mox change hands. Dead Lands registered renewed turbulence at Callahan's Gate, leaving the entire eleven-post hex under Colonial authority for now. Farther east, Stlican Shelf shifted into a five-to-four Colonial edge before base captures stalled, mirroring a pause in transitions across Stonecradle where brutal attritional fighting continues unabated. Meanwhile, Mooring County is enduring a ferocious storm of fire, sustaining more than 2,100 combined casualties in two hours with rising enlistments as Wardens press the single remaining Colonial pocket.
